Famous long-standing bar in Hue
Sep 2026 • Business
In 1996, I came to DMZ Bar for the first time; at that time, it was probably the only bar in the Le Loi area of Hue with a small scale, one floor, simple decor, dim lighting, with a pool table in the middle of the bar, and the customers were mainly foreigners.

On August 30, 2026, I returned to DMZ Bar after exactly 30 years and saw that it had completely changed. The restaurant has expanded much more, to two floors, with private dining rooms and an outdoor dining area on the upper floor. Local diners were also quite numerous.

The food and drinks are quite rich with relatively stable quality. The service staff are quick, enthusiastic, and polite. The prices are a bit higher than other bars in the area and on the pedestrian street.

Sitting on the balcony of DMZ Bar in the evening, enjoying a few cold drinks and watching the bustling traffic on Le Loi street is an experience you should try when visiting Hue.
